description.en: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
description.zh: 手持能秒杀你的植物的火把。

chat.en: Not even should the cook of the Kongfu Temple be underestimated.
chat.zh: 即使他是少林寺的伙夫，其实力也不容小觑。

text.en: torch destroys a plant on contact
text.zh: 火把迅速烧毁接触到的植物

text.en: breathes fire towards plants that are close enough, dealing deadly damages
text.zh: 向接近的植物吐出火焰，造成大量伤害
冰冻攻击能使火把熄灭
